newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Cemento Argos '96 net rose 9.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cemento Argos '96 net rose 9.0 percent.

text.p: Compania de Cemento Argos SA, the leading cement company of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, said its net profit totaled 91.12 billion pesos in 1996, a 9.0 percent increase over 1995.
It said its operating income fell by 10 percent from 1995 to 2.86 billion pesos. But total assets as of year-end 1996 were up 12 pct over year-end 1995 at 1.13 trillion pesos.

Argos is the biggest of nine cement companies owned and operated by the Sindicato Antioqueno, which controls 53 percent of Colombia's cement market. A sharp slowdown in the construction sector cut sharply into the income of most cement manfacturers last year. ((-- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
